brief:
@buildthis.bisks.net app to see which mutuals have standard.site publications but haven't published in a while so I can encourage em to publish more! call it "Standard Incite!" lol…

basic version = I enter handle to query & you list mutuals with their pub(s) & date of last post if > 1 month ago
note: standard incite! is live — type a handle, it checks every mutual's own PDS for a standard.site publication and flags anyone idle 30+ days with a one-tap nudge to send them.
